osChoice.supportsAlwaysOnAgentNode: Yes with work: OpenSSH Server is an optional feature with auto-start and a firewall rule (s08). Update restarts follow active hours (default 8-17, max 18h range); the 'no auto-restart with logged on users' policy is documented as not working as described, and several restart policies are legacy and not applicable to Windows 11 (s09). An unattended 20-session agent box will reboot on Microsoft's schedule unless policy or compliance deadlines are used. Home vs Pro policy availability not verified (OPEN).
osChoice.supportsStrixHaloLlm: Yes. Lemonade supports Windows 11 with vulkan/rocm/flm/ryzenai-llm backends and gfx1151 (s02). AMD Variable Graphics Memory reportedly lets 96GB of 128GB act as VRAM on Windows (s06; AMD blog s07 not opened). NPU via FastFlowLM works on Windows (s03).
knownLimits: Windows GPU memory cap reported as 96GB of 128GB via VGM, versus roughly 124GB GTT on Linux with kernel params (s01, s06; secondary sources)
WSL2 VM defaults to 50% of host RAM and NAT networking; set .wslconfig memory/networkingMode explicitly (s10)
Linux-first community tooling: strix-halo-toolboxes and llm-tracker benchmarks are Linux only (s01, s05); no Windows-vs-Linux benchmark found, so any speed gap is a GAP
Forced update reboots kill long agent sessions unless sessions run under a supervisor that restarts them (inference from s09)

gapItems.finding: Tailscale free Personal plan allows up to 6 users and unlimited user devices, enough for a solo founder. OpenSSH Server is a Windows 11 Feature on Demand with an auto-created TCP 22 firewall rule. Cloudflare Tunnel is outbound-only and cloudflared has Windows exe/MSI but does not auto-update on Windows. Windows Home cannot host incoming Remote Desktop, Pro can.

gapItems.finding: Official docs give few VRAM figures. Wan2.2 TI2V-5B needs at least 24GB, A14B at least 80GB (single GPU, offload flags reduce). HunyuanVideo needs 60GB for 720p129f, 45GB for 540p129f, 80GB recommended, Linux NVIDIA CUDA. FLUX.1-dev is 12B BF16 non-commercial; SDXL card gives no VRAM number; LTX-Video gives no total VRAM table (CUDA 12.2 tested). Diffusers LoRA guide gives no SDXL/Flux figure.
gapItems.recommendation: A 128GB Strix Halo covers capacity on paper for Wan/Hunyuan, but HunyuanVideo and LTX docs target NVIDIA CUDA; treat ROCm/Vulkan support as unverified and test before relying on it.

Universal Control is Apple-only: one Mac plus up to two other Mac/iPad, same Apple Account. Parsec page returned 403; Microsoft Remote Desktop client and SMB were not researched.

gapItems.finding: Linux side is documented: AMD ROCm docs say default GTT is about 50% of RAM, raisable via TTM pages_limit, with a 100GB example on a 125.65GB system. The Windows 96GB cap is NOT confirmed from a primary page: the AMD blog fetch timed out twice; only a secondary search summary mentions 96GB VGM on Windows (Adrenalin 25.8.1). A 124GB Linux figure is also not on the ROCm page.
gapItems.recommendation: Assume ~96GB Windows and ~100GB+ Linux as unconfirmed; run the local-LLM box on Linux if memory ceiling matters, and measure.
